subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block first by lifting the rightmost inverted cup with the right hand and placing it back in front of the red block. Leave the other two blocks covered.
Turn the rightmost yellow cup lying on its side in front of red back onto its open rim, with its closed base up. Keep red uncovered and leave the other two cups in place.
Uncover the green block by lifting the middle inverted cup vertically, then set the cup rim down on the table in front of the green block. Leave the left cup covering blue and keep red exposed.
Uncover the blue block at the leftmost position. Lift its inverted yellow cup clear of the block with the left gripper, then place the cup rim down in front of blue and release it.
Return both arms to their respective episode-start poses with both grippers fully open. Leave all three blocks exposed and all cups inverted in front of the blocks.
